laws.rule: No one may drive while using a mobile electronic device (SDCL 32-26-47.1), and police can stop a driver for it alone. Allowed: emergency calls, GPS navigation (but not typing into it while driving), selecting a name or number to make or take a call and talking on that call, switching a feature on or off, and voice or hands-free use. Breaking the rule is a Class 2 misdemeanour.

To stop aquatic invasive species (pest mussels and plants carried on boats), all trailered boats must have drain plugs, bailers and valves opened or removed except at a boat ramp parking area or while launching or loading, and fish and bait may not be carried in water taken from a lake, river or stream. Anyone taking a boat out of the water must clean and drain it (SDCL 41-13A-4), and vehicles carrying boats must stop at any open inspection station. Breaking the cleaning and draining rule is a Class 2 misdemeanour.

items.text: South Dakota allows medical cannabis only, and buying or selling cannabis outside the state's licensed medical cannabis establishments is illegal (SDCL 34-20G). A visitor with a valid medical cannabis card from another US state, territory or recognised country can be a nonresident cardholder, but only after registering with the South Dakota Department of Health and receiving confirmation; the card alone is not enough. Registration needs a practitioner's statement and proof the person may possess cannabis at home, and a nonresident may name no more than two dispensaries.
A registered nonresident cardholder is protected for buying, carrying and using up to 3 ounces (about 85 g) of cannabis, and a dispensary may sell a patient no more than 3 ounces in any 14 days.
